sources.source_title: MetaVC Partners Raises $62 Million Fund to Invest in Hard-Tech Metamaterials Startups
sources.quote: April 12, 2023 SAN FRANCISCO, April 12, 2023 /PRNewswire/ -- MetaVC Partners today announced the close of MetaVC Partners, LLC., a $62 million fund that will invest in early-stage, hard-tech metamaterials startup companies. sources.source_title: MetaVC Partners Raises $62 Million Fund to Invest in Hard-Tech Metamaterials Startups
sources.quote: Among MetaVC Partners' current investments: Lumotive uses the physics of metamaterials to produce tiny semiconductor scanning sensors for anti-collision systems and consumer electronics applications. Mangata Networks is building a proprietary network of satellites and terrestrial systems to bring low-cost, ubiquitous connectivity to networks, data, and devices. Imagia uses metamaterials to produce flat-optical lens technologies used in AR/VR headsets and other consumer electronics products. Neurophos is building high-performance optical AI processors that will be over one hundred times faster and more energy-efficient than today's state-of-the-art AI computer processors.
